_comment: Jev routing table v3, chosen by evaluating Jev's verdicts against answers from every target; the X column (Gemini 4 Argon, Codex for quick) and create's H cell (Claude Sonnet 5.5) were set on 2026-10-16 without a new evaluation. Each type has one target per difficulty band L/M/H/X (Jev's 10-level score: 1-3 L, 4-6 M, 7-8 H, 9-10 X), written like a stored model with its effort; 'codex' is CODEX_MODEL. Every cell is checked at start-up and a bad one stops the Bot.
_comment_needs: A type that only these backends can answer (live X posts need Grok's X search; the Bot's own <web>, <fetch> and <run> work for every model). Every cell of it must be on that backend.
_comment_image: A message with an image is not judged (Jev reads text only): it goes down this list in order, each one when the one before cannot answer, then on along MODEL_CHAIN. A conversation already on a Codex cell keeps that cell (and its band) for the image.
_comment_degrade: Quota and failure stand-ins, tried before MODEL_CHAIN. grok_spent: a Grok cell while chat is past GROK_CHAT_MAX_WEEKLY_PERCENT, the breaker is open or Grok is off. live_x_without_grok: an X question when Grok cannot answer at all (the answer says it had no X search). claude_failed: an agy Claude cell that failed, by type. argon_failed: an Argon cell that failed (its small weekly pool spent, a 429), by type: the cell it replaced. codex_quota: at or past these used percentages Codex effort drops one level.
